note: Problems with exact numeric answers, to measure mathematical accuracy without tools.

problems.question: A fair six-sided die is rolled 4 times. What is the probability of getting at least one six?
In a room of 23 people, assuming 365 equally likely birthdays and no leap years, what is the probability that at least two people share a birthday?
X is uniform on (0, 1) and Y = X^2. What is P(Y <= 0.25)?
X follows a Binomial distribution with n = 10 and p = 0.3. What is Var(X)?
X follows a Poisson distribution with mean 2. What is P(X = 0)?
A disease has prevalence 1%. A test has sensitivity 95% and a false positive rate of 10%. What is the probability of having the disease given a positive test?
What is E[X^2] for a single roll of a fair six-sided die?
X is exponential with rate 0.5. What is P(X > 3)?
Compute the integral of x^2 from 0 to 1.
X is the number of trials until the first success, with success probability 0.2 on each independent trial. What is E[X]?
A population has standard deviation 10. What is the standard error of the sample mean for samples of size 25?
In how many ways can you choose 3 people from a group of 10?
X and Y are independent and each uniform on (0, 1). What is Var(X + Y)?
X is exponential with rate 2. What is E[X^2]?
X is normal with mean 100 and standard deviation 15. What is P(X > 130)?
You flip a fair coin 10 times. What is the probability of exactly 5 heads?
X has density f(x) = 3x^2 on [0, 1]. What is E[X]?
A bag has 4 red and 6 blue marbles. You draw 2 without replacement. What is the probability that both are red?
